title: mps-silent-failures: sweep harness, guard and results for silent failures of PyTorch's MPS backend at the 2^32 boundary
description:
Code, guard and raw results for the technical report Silent Failures at the 2^32 Boundary: A Technical Report on Large-Tensor Matrix Multiplication in PyTorch's Apple MPS Backend.

On macOS 27.0, PyTorch's MPS backend returns wrong values without an error for batched matrix multiplication on tensors with more than 2^32 elements, in every PyTorch release from 2.4.1 to 2.14.0 that was tested. This record contains the boundary sweep harness (scan.py, worker.py), the first-pass suite, a guard that stops any MPS operation touching 2^32 or more elements (firstpass/mps_guard.py), the case study on a public sentiment classifier, the raw results of every run with their manifests, and the report (paper.pdf).
